passive.lavagenesis.ember: Spark: immune to fire and lava, sees a few blocks through lava. Melts the snow and ice it touches and lights candles and campfires. Water snuffs you out in seconds - stay in your chamber.
passive.lavagenesis.ember.title: Spark
passive.lavagenesis.magma_droplet: Lava Dart: you shoot through lava much faster than before and lava drips from your body. You can now dart through water for a few seconds.
passive.lavagenesis.magma_droplet.title: Lava Dart
passive.lavagenesis.lava_flow: Glowing Trail: the ground glows where you flow, and water cools you far more slowly.
passive.lavagenesis.lava_flow.title: Glowing Trail
passive.lavagenesis.seamount: Deep Fire: you breathe underwater and swim like a fish - the sea barely cools a seamount. Your body is now a crusted lava golem.
passive.lavagenesis.seamount.title: Deep Fire
passive.lavagenesis.islet: Lava-Walking: water under your steps turns into cooling lava, building land as you walk. Sneak to sink into the sea instead.
passive.lavagenesis.islet.title: Lava-Walking
passive.lavagenesis.shield_island: Fire Aura: anything that strikes you bursts into flames. Your lava-walk path widens.
passive.lavagenesis.shield_island.title: Fire Aura
passive.lavagenesis.island_chain: Steam Jump: jump while swimming at the surface to burst out of the sea on a column of steam.
passive.lavagenesis.island_chain.title: Steam Jump
passive.lavagenesis.archipelago: Lava Sight: you see in the dark and far through lava.
passive.lavagenesis.archipelago.title: Lava Sight
passive.lavagenesis.great_volcano: Ash Plume: you can fly (double-tap jump), trailing ash and smoke.
passive.lavagenesis.great_volcano.title: Ash Plume
form.lavagenesis.heat.crusting: Your crust is hardening - find lava, fire or your vent!
death.attack.lavagenesis.solidified.play: %1$s cooled and solidified into stone while fighting %2$s
